From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Full loop scheduling: Sanjay Rao — draft sequence and constraints

Hi all,

We have a strong candidate (Sanjay Rao) for SWE3 IC. He's asked for a virtual full loop next Wednesday (7/13) in the morning Pacific time. Below is my initial thought for a 4-slot sequence with short breaks — please confirm your availability and any ordering preferences by EOD today.

Proposed sequence (45/45/45/30 + 15 min buffer between blocks):
- Intro / System design (45) — Jonas
- Backend deep dive (45) — Irene
- Product + cross-team (45) — Marissa
- Behavioral / wrap / bar-raising (30) — Hiring manager / me

Constraints:
- Candidate is remote (India, UTC+5:30) and has requested start no earlier than 10:30 AM PDT (which is 11:00 PM IST) — so we should aim for 11:00 AM PDT start.
- Please review the attached resume (sanjay_rao_resume.pdf) and the runbook (onsite_runbook_v2.docx). The runbook includes the Zoom links, interviewer templates, and the short scoring rubric.

If anyone needs to swap slots I can re-sequence, but I want to lock this by EOD so I can confirm with the candidate and calendar out rooms.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad | Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference
Attachment: sanjay_rao_resume.pdf (PDF, 220 KB); onsite_runbook_v2.docx (DOCX, 120 KB)

Marissa — are you okay being third? If not, I can take product and you take backend.

Hi Sanjay — thanks again for your flexibility. We're locking in your virtual full loop for Wednesday, July 13, starting at 11:00 AM PDT. Below are the confirmed slots (all Zoom links are in the attached runbook and calendar invites):

Final slot sequence (all times PDT):
- 11:00–11:45 — Backend deep dive — Irene Choi
- 12:00–12:45 — System design / infra — Jonas Weber
- 13:00–13:45 — Product + cross-team — Marissa Cole (includes 5-min clarifier at top)
- 14:00–14:30 — Behavioral + wrap — Mina Haddad (hiring manager join)

Please confirm you can attend the times above. Attached: sanjay_rao_resume.pdf; onsite_runbook_v2.docx (contains Zoom links, interviewer notes, candidate prep doc).

Quick logistical notes for candidate:
- Please join the Zoom 5 minutes before your first slot for audio/video check.
- We'll keep each session tight; interviewers will use a shared scorecard and provide a short recap in the final 15 minutes if time allows.

If anything changes, reply-all and we'll triage.

Regards,
